This is a data set that contains eighty-six (86) scans of the Markinch Grain Elevator and associated east and west annex, Markinch. All data was collected by the Capture2Preserv team between the 7th and 8th of June 2024. The Z+F 5010X and the BLK 360 G1 laser scanners were both used to collected data of the elevator and associated annexes.  The Z+F 5010X scanner was used to collect thirty-two (32) exterior scans of the grain elevator and east annex and eighteen (18) exterior scans of the west anned, which were registered in Z+F Laser Control and further processed in Autodesk ReCap Pro. The Leica BLK 360 G1 scanner was used to collect thirty-one (31) interior scans of the grain elevator and five (5) interior scans of the east annex, which were registered in Cyclone REGISTER 360 PLUS and further processed in Autodesk ReCap Pro. Data were exported to LAS in CloudCompare.
